info.title: mcs
info.description: Scaffolding for a MagicCSharp repository: create services, domains, shared libraries and entities, and lint the conventions the compiler cannot. Install globally with 'dotnet tool install -g MagicCSharp.Cli', or per repository with a tool manifest so the whole team gets the same version.

commands.name: add-entity
commands.description: Create an entity and its repository

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --solution
options.description:
Which service, e.g. 'Shop'. Omit when the
repository has only one

options.name: --name
options.description: Entity name in PascalCase, e.g. 'Order'

options.name: --domain
options.description:
Owning domain, e.g. 'Orders'. Dots for a
subdomain: 'Orders.Fulfilment'

options.name: --use-key
options.description:
Key by an unguessable string instead of a
Snowflake id. Use when the key is public

options.name: --paginated
options.description: Also give the repository page-at-a-time reads

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --name
options.description: Service name, one PascalCase word, e.g. 'Shop'

options.name: --database
options.description:
Database name, lowercase with underscores.
Implies data projects

options.name: --no-database
options.description:
Create no data projects — for a service that
owns no tables

options.name: --port
options.description:
Local development port. Defaults to one no
other service has claimed
